package_version_source: docs/literature/raw/description_ltmle_verified.txt; repository declaration, not proof of latest published release
capabilities: Longitudinal TMLE of treatment/censoring-specific means and marginal structural models
limitation: Censoring, intervention support and chronological node semantics need explicit checks
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Wide data whose column order is causal time, binary treatment and censoring/event nodes, regime/rule and nuisance specifications.
scientific_qualification.output: Regime mean or MSM projection, TMLE/IPTW (or G-computation), influence values and bounded/unbounded cumulative probabilities.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Sequential identification and censoring restrictions, regime support and estimator-specific regularity.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Validate chronology independently of column positions before constructing the input. Binary Anodes only; absorbing event coding must be coherent. Record Yrange truncation, gbounds on cumulative probabilities, sampling weights and id. Robust variance variants exclude several outcome/options combinations.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Use finite-law g-formula/DR identities and a column permutation that would reverse chronology; require rejection before fitting. Show how outcome clipping and cumulative probability bounding change bias/target behavior.

evidence.finding: Column-order chronology, binary actions, absorbing survival events, outcome scaling/truncation and dynamic rules.
Cumulative gbounds, observation weights, variance restrictions, id and returned influence/cumulative-probability objects.

pinned_api_revision.scope: Inspected API files at this commit; not an assertion about all README bytes or the published package release.
